items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Yes, indeed, I know him. A little old Rabbit Brown.

ctx.x: Did you know that song about the downfall of the lion? You remember Rabbit Brown used to be?
Rabbit Brown, yeah, I know. Rabbit Brown, yeah. Oh, you knew him? Yeah, did I know him? Yes, indeed, I know him. A little old Rabbit Brown.
Where did he used to be?
